meta.goal: Implementar Unified Gateway (:7999) como ponto único de entrada, eliminando duplicações de NLU (1.303 LOC), PII (1.051 LOC), Approval (~2.000 LOC) e autenticação descentralizada
non_goals: Reimplementação completa dos fluxos A-F, G, H

invariants: INV-1: NLU Result Compatibility - NLU Service must return compatible NLUResult with domain, entities, confidence, keywords
INV-2: PII Detection Types - PII Service must detect same 7 types (EMAIL, PHONE, CPF, CNPJ, CREDIT_CARD, SSN, ADDRESS) with positions
INV-3: Approval Decision Format - Approval Core must produce same ApprovalDecision format with decision, approved_by, approved_at, rejection_reason
INV-4: Kafka Topic Contracts - Topic names (plan_approvals, plan_approvals_responses, specialist_feedback) and message formats must not change
INV-5: Intent Envelope Structure - Intent envelope must preserve text, domain, entities, context fields
INV-6: Approval Request Lifecycle - Status transitions PENDING→APPROVED/REJECTED only, revert only via Saga compensation
INV-7: Authentication Context - JWT tokens validated by Unified Gateway must pass user_id, tenant_id to downstream services
INV-8: Rate Limiting Behavior - Applied per-tenant before reaching downstream services, returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After
INV-9: Original Intent Text Preservation - Original text preserved through entire pipeline for Active Learning
INV-10: Health Check Compatibility - All services respond to GET /health with {status, version} JSON
INV-11: Observability Context - Distributed tracing propagated via traceparent header across HTTP/gRPC
INV-12: Graceful Degradation - If NLU/PII services down, fall back to local implementations during transition
INV-13: PII Audit Logging - All PII masking operations logged to MongoDB pii_audit_log collection
INV-14: PII Unmask Reversibility - MASK_REDACT must support reversible unmasking via AES-256-GCM encrypted tokens

journeys.name: cliente simplificado - unico endpoint /api/v1/nhm/request
journeys.given: Cliente com request de qualquer tipo (A-F, G, H)
journeys.when: Envia para POST /api/v1/nhm/request → Unified Gateway classifica → Flow Router roteia → Cliente recebe resposta
journeys.then: Cliente recebe resposta correta sem conhecer complexidade interna ou fluxo específico

journeys.name: administração centralizada - auth e rate limiting em um lugar
journeys.given: Operador do sistema precisa gerenciar auth e rate limiting
journeys.when: Configura políticas no Unified Gateway → Todas requests passam pelo gateway → Auth e rate limiting aplicados
journeys.then: Serviços downstream recebem requests já autenticadas, operação simplificada

journeys.name: consistencia de NLU e PII - versao centralizada
journeys.given: Desenvolvedor precisa atualizar lógica de NLU ou PII
journeys.when: NLU Service ou PII Service central atualizado → Todos os fluxos usam mesma versão via gRPC
journeys.then: Resultados consistentes independente do fluxo, manutenção em um único lugar

journeys.name: [regression] fluxo A-F preservado apos refactor gateway-intencoes
journeys.given: Fluxo A-F (Cognitive Pipeline) funciona com gateway-intencoes:8000
journeys.when: gateway-intencoes refatorado para proxy NLU/PII services via gRPC
journeys.then: Comportamento idêntico ao pré-refatoração, mesma funcionalidade preservada

journeys.name: [regression] fluxo G preservado apos refactor approval-service
journeys.given: Fluxo G (Code Generation) funciona com approval-service:8004
journeys.when: approval-service refatorado para usar Approval Core Package neural_hive_approval_common
journeys.then: Comportamento idêntico ao pré-refatoração, lógica de approval preservada
